Title: Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - November 3, 2025
Subtitle: [Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - November 3, 2025] Our next Heroes of the Storm patch has just hit the Public Test Realm and will be available for playtesting. View Full Article
Highlights: [Heroes of the Storm PTR Patch Notes - November 3, 2025] Our next Heroes of the Storm patch has just hit the Public Test Realm and will be available for playtesting. View Full Article
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Updates]
  Experience:
  • The comeback system has been slightly magnified, particularly at wide level gaps.
  A Call for Help:
  • Forts, Keeps, and Core will no longer grant nearby allied Heroes that take damage 35 Armor for 4 seconds.
  • Basic Attacks from Core, Keeps, Forts, Fallback Towers, and Keep's Towers will now reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes hit.
  • [Undocumented] Damage from the Towers of Doom's Kill Zone now reduces Armor.
  Structures:
  • Fallback Towers
    • Fallback Towers have been added [Undocumented] behind Forts in the longer lanes.
    • Fallback Towers have the same Health and Attack Damage as Keep's Towers.
  Gameplay:
  • Ability ranges on numerous Heroes have been updated to be more consistent.
  Quests:
  • Players will now receive a personal-only announcement when an intermediate Quest Reward is unlocked.

=== Heroes: Falstad ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Gathering Storm
      • Rework: Bonuses are now provided at 30/80/150 stacks, rather than incremental gains. At 30 stacks, gain 30% damage. At 80 stacks, gain 50% damage. Pinnacle Reward: At 150 stacks, gain 70% damage.
      • Rework: Lose 8 stacks on death, but can not lose milestones that have already been completed.
    • Dishonorable Discharge
      • Rework: Bonuses are now provided at 20/45/75 hits. At 20 hits, gain 30% damage. At 45 hits, gain 75% damage and reduces the cooldown by 2 seconds. Pinnacle Reward: At 75 hits, Lightning Rod provides 2 additional strikes.
    • Frequent Flyer
      • Rework: Reduced attack speed bonus from 40% to 25%. Now provides 1 stack per minion and 5 stacks per Hero. At 50 stacks, gain 20 attack damage. At 125 stacks, gain 50 attack damage. Pinnacle Reward: At 300 stacks, gain 125 attack damage.
  • Level 7
    • Thunderstrikes
      • Moved from Level 13 to Level 7.
  • Level 13
    • Charged Up
      • Moved from Level 7 to Level 13.
      • No longer provides additional hits, but instead provides cooldown refresh on Hero takedowns.

=== Heroes: Sylvanas ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Black Arrows [D]
    • Black Arrows now refers to what was previously called Banshee's Curse.
    • New Baseline Quest: Deal damage to non-Minions with 3 stacks of Black Arrows. At 200 stacks, increased the damage bonus of Black Arrows to 50%. Pinnacle Reward: At 400 stacks, heal for 50% of damage dealt against enemies with 3 stacks of Black Arrows.
    • Reduced base damage bonus of Black Arrows to 15%.
    • Activatable portion of Black Arrows has been removed.
  • Possession [1]
    • Activate to force an enemy Minion to fight for Sylvanas's team. Catapults require 4 charges. Stores up to 4 charges. 25 seconds cooldown. 2 seconds cooldown between charges.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Unfurling Shadows
      • Removed.
    • (New) Unrelenting Torment
      • Increases the damage of Shadow Dagger by 20% and increase its duration by 1 second.
  • Level 4
    • (New) Haunting Arrows
      • You can now activate Black Arrows to cause all damage dealt to Stun non-Heroes. 90 second cooldown, reduced by 3 seconds when attacking a Structure.
    • Possession
      • Moved from Level 4 to Baseline Active.
  • Level 7
    • Barbed Shot
      • Bonus damage increased from 350% to 400%.
    • Lost Soul
      • Rework: Reduces the cooldown of Shadow Dagger when attacking non-Minions with 3 stacks of Black Arrows by .75 seconds, doubled against Heroes.
  • Level 13
    • Windrunner
      • Recast window reduced from 5 seconds to 4 seconds.

=== Heroes: Thrall ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Echo of the Elements
      • Rework: Bonuses are now provided at 20/40/100 stacks. At 20 stacks, reduce mana cost of Chain Lightning by 20. At 40 stacks, Chain Lightning will bounce one additional time. Pinnacle Reward: At 100 stacks, Chain Lightning gains an extra charge.
    • Crash Lightning
      • Rework: Bonuses are now provided at 15 and 30 stacks. At each milestone, Chain Lightning gains 240 damage. Lose 6 stacks on death, but can not lose milestones that have already been completed.
    • Maelstrom Weapon
      • Moved from Level 7 to Level 1.
      • Rework: Bonuses are now provided at 20/40/100 stacks, rather than incremental gains. At 20 stacks, gain 20 damage. At 40 stacks, gain 40 damage in addition to the previous benefits. Pinnacle Reward: At 100 stacks, Frostwolf Resilience now provides +200% Healing.
  • Level 7
    • Rolling Thunder
      • Moved from Level 4 to Level 7.
      • No longer increases Chain Lightning bounces by 1.
  • Level 16
    • Tempest Fury
      • No longer provides additional quest stacks.
    • Thunderstorm
      • Increased damage bonus provided at max stacks from 25% to 30%.
  • Level 20
    • Wind Rush
      • Cooldown increased from 80 seconds to 90 seconds.
